challenges.challenge: Does 0080 backfill of the superseded three-segment form rewrite entity_id, or only denorm columns?
challenges.resolution: ONLY denorm. Rows with entity_id smartfile:48021:udc get scope_type=jurisdiction and scope_id=48021, but entity_id stays three-segment. parseSmartFileEntityId of that stored value returns null. Storage would persist a string the declared parser cannot read. Fail-closed: rewrite entity_id to smartfile:jurisdiction:<fips>:<docSlug> in the same UPDATE, or refuse the backfill (empty deployment makes rewrite safe).

challenges.challenge: Is empty-string jurisdiction_fips on smart_file_absence_determinations a surviving guardrail?

An empty result is not an absence; an empty FIPS is a synthesized city. 0080 must ALTER absence.jurisdiction_fips DROP NOT NULL and the store must write NULL. Do not rewrite 0079.
